summary: Completed regression testing for Daleel refactor (Feb 2026). Pydantic models extracted to /app/backend/models/schemas.py and helper utilities to /app/backend/core/utils.py work correctly. PriceIntelPage split into 4 sub-components under /app/frontend/src/components/priceIntel/ renders correctly.

issues: Recharts console warning about chart dimensions (-1x-1) when price history chart container not fully visible - non-critical

passed_tests: GET /api/health returns healthy/connected (MongoDB connected, scheduler jobs running)
GET /api/auth/me with admin token returns user (admin@daleelpets.com)
GET /api/my-products?days=7 returns kpis + products
GET /api/products/{sku}/full?days=30 returns aggregated payload (store_prices, history, velocity)
POST /api/auth/login parses AuthIn model correctly
POST /api/stores parses StoreIn model correctly
POST /api/alerts parses AlertIn model correctly
POST /api/saved-filters parses SavedFilterIn model correctly
POST /api/import/run-matching parses MatchActionIn model correctly
POST /api/crawler/ingest parses IngestPayload model correctly (with bearer token)
GET /api/insights/summary responds 200
GET /api/insights/leaderboard responds 200
GET /api/scanner/opportunities responds 200
GET /api/discounts/top-pct responds 200
GET /api/discounts/top-amount responds 200
GET /api/stores/{store_id}/profile returns profile data
get_stock_signal helper works (products have valid stock_signal values)
_estimate_sales_from_snapshots helper works (KPIs have total_units_sold, total_revenue)
compute_product_metrics helper works (store_prices have computed metrics)
GET /api/price-intel/dashboard responds 200 with summary, action_required, my_advantages, full_table, confidence_distribution
GET /api/baseline/leaderboard responds 200
GET /api/baseline/catalog-gaps responds 200
Frontend: Price Intel page loads with data-testid=price-intel-page
Frontend: KPI row shows 6 cards (My Products, Matched, Overpriced RED/YELLOW, I'm Cheapest, OOS Opportunity)
Frontend: Confidence distribution bar renders with segments
Frontend: Confidence guide toggle (data-testid=toggle-guide) shows/hides guide panel
Frontend: Market Position widget shows store ranking (#12 of 13 stores)
Frontend: All 5 tabs present (data-testid=tab-action, tab-advantage, tab-full, tab-unverified, tab-gaps)
Frontend: Each tab renders its corresponding table
Frontend: Clicking row opens detail sheet (data-testid=product-detail-sheet)
Frontend: Detail sheet shows ConfidenceBadge, Confirm/Reject buttons
Frontend: Theme toggle (data-testid=theme-toggle-btn) switches between dark/light themes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor regression complete. Pydantic models (AuthIn, StoreIn, StoreUpdate, AlertIn, SavedFilterIn, Tier4CredentialsIn, OtpSubmitIn, MatchActionIn, IngestPayload) now imported from /app/backend/models/schemas.py. Helper utilities (PLACEHOLDER_QTY_VALUES, MAX_QTY_DELTA_PER_INTERVAL, MAX_DAILY_SALES_PER_SKU, get_stock_signal, _coerce_num, _coerce_int, _estimate_sales_from_snapshots, compute_product_metrics) now imported from /app/backend/core/utils.py. PriceIntelPage.jsx (135 lines) orchestrates 4 sub-components: PriceIntelShared.jsx (ConfidenceBadge, FlagBadges), PriceIntelHeader.jsx (KpiRow, ConfidenceDistribution, ConfidenceGuidePanel, MarketPositionWidget), PriceIntelTabs.jsx (5 table components), PriceIntelDetailSheet.jsx (detail sheet with price history chart).
